title: SEAVT named JSON/SEN carrier profile v2
description: An opt-in, named, JSON-Lines-carried projection of an admitted SEAVT row. Exactly one JSON bridge image or closed SEN term per coordinate; semantic SEN admission and calendar checks remain with the original upstream evaluators. Legacy v1 is a separate unmodified profile.

witnessTime.description: Original EAVT witness coordinate when distinct from filedAt; source-qualified by SEAVT admission.

entityJson.description: JSON value whose original SEN bridge image is the entity coordinate.

attributeJson.description: JSON value whose original SEN bridge image is the attribute coordinate.

valueJson.description: JSON value whose original SEN bridge image is the value coordinate.

senTerm.description: An original closed, inferable SEN term; validate through the upstream seavtRow reader, not an invented nested-term grammar.
